channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Dispatch Simulator
item.description: Answer 911 calls with your own voice. Every caller hears what you say and answers back: panicked, confused, sometimes barely able to speak. Pull out the details that matter, find them on the map, and send police, fire, and EMS. Work the shift solo or with up to six dispatchers.

item.title: LEGO® Horizon Adventures™
item.description: Join machine hunter Aloy as she leads a colourful crew of heroes on a quest to save the world and learn the secrets of her past. Dive into boundless adventure, customize to your heart’s content, and take on action-packed battles solo or with friends.

item.title: Age of Empires IV: Yue Fei's Legacy
item.description: Experience the story of the great Chinese Song Dynasty general Yue Fei during the Song-Jin wars in a new 8-mission campaign. Then command the opposing faction, the Jin Dynasty, leading strong cavalry and siege units into battle in skirmish and multiplayer.

item.title: Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition
item.description: Lead powerful civilizations across the globe, master strategies and tactics, and relive history in co op battles—now remastered in stunning 4K and modernized gameplay.

item.title: Farewell North
item.description: Play as a border collie and restore color to your human’s world in an atmospheric journey through the northern isles of Scotland. Explore land and sea, uncover hidden paths, herd animals and free wildlife to bring color back to her world, while revealing an emotional story about saying farewell.

item.title: Gears of War: E-Day
item.description: Experience Emergence Day – the brutal origin story of one of gaming’s most acclaimed third-person shooter franchises.

item.title: Stupid Never Dies
item.description: Turn weak zombie Davy stupid strong, stupid fast in this Blazing Fast Growth action RPG! Devour enemies, steal powers, transform, and brave a deadly dungeon to revive frozen Julia.

item.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 12
item.description: Escape the ordinary with The Jackbox Party Pack 12! Embark on a party adventure with goofy greetings in We Forgot a Card, wild image warping in Hyperface, absurd arguments in Debate and Switch, team-based fact battles in Idol Factions, and mind-melding friendship in MegaPals.

item.title: Tower Wizard
item.description: Help a wizard build and upgrade a wizard tower in this incremental game! Use the tower to study magic, summon spirits, create buildings, and influence the world.

item.title: Warlords IV: Heroes of Etheria
item.description: Warlords IV: Heroes of Etheria is a turn-based fantasy strategy game of conquest and heroes. Capture cities, recruit armies from ten distinct factions, level up your units, and clash in fast one-on-one duels where the marching order you choose decides the battle.

item.title: WE'RE ALL IN!
item.description: Experience minigame chaos in WE’RE ALL IN!, an online party game for 1-8 players where you win by betting on your friends in a series of fast-paced games and challenges.
